tasks.title: Conversation #78
tasks.transcript:
Man: I've been trying to get in shape, but I'm not having much success. You know a lot about fitness. What am I doing wrong?
Woman: The most important thing is staying motivated. Yes, that's been a problem for me. You should set small, achievable goals. Seeing your progress can be very motivating.
Man:I see what you're saying.
Woman: You might also want to think about joining a fitness class. Working out with others can keep you motivated and accountable.
Man: That's a great idea. I'll go online and see what's available.

options.A: He lacks the incentive to exercise regularly.
options.B: He cannot find a gym he likes.
options.C: A class he wanted to join has been canceled.
options.D: He set a goal he could not achieve.

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目的意思是：男士的问题是什么？ 选项分析： A. He lacks the incentive to exercise regularly. 对话中男士提到塑形不成功（I've been trying to get in shape, but I'm not having much success.），女士指出最重要的是“staying motivated”（保持动力），并给出了设定小目标、参加课程等建议来解决动力问题。这说明男士的问题核心在于缺乏坚持锻炼的动力，符合题意。 B. He cannot find a gym he likes. 对话中未提及他在寻找健身房或不喜欢某家健身房。 C. A class he wanted to join has been canceled. 对话中未提及课程被取消。 D. He set a goal he could not achieve. 女士建议他设定“small, achievable goals”（可实现的小目标），暗示他之前可能目标过高，但并未明确说这是他的主要问题，主要问题还是归结于缺乏动力和成功体验。

questions.stem: What will the man most likely do next?

options.A: Invite the woman to work out with him
options.B: Review his list of fitness goals
options.C: Make an appointment with a personal trainer
options.D: Choose from a list of fitness classes

questions.analysis: 答案：D 题目的意思是：男士接下来最可能做什么？ 选项分析： A. Invite the woman to work out with him. 男士只是说这是个好主意，并未邀请女士一起锻炼。 B. Review his list of fitness goals. 文中未提及他已经有了目标清单需要回顾。 C. Make an appointment with a personal trainer. 文中未提及私人教练。 D. Choose from a list of fitness classes. 男士最后说“I’ll go online and see what’s available”（我会上网看看有什么课程），这与女士建议的“joining a fitness class”相对应，意味着他将去查看并选择课程，符合题意。
